Name: Stoned in the Valley
Author: D00kieMaster
Description:
[center][/center][left][center]﻿[img]https://i.imgur.com/My87Cys.png[/img]
[size=5][b]Stoned in the Valley [/b]introduces marijuana and cannabis into Stardew Valley! This mod really wants to showcase the different uses and effects of all types of cannabis including hemp. Cannabis in all forms is a very useful and beneficial plant and would be a wonderful addition to anyone's farm. Made by someone who works in cannabis, this mod aims to celebrate the cultivation and growing of selling in Stardew![/size]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/7tcuEa5.png[/img]
[size=5][b]- 5 New crops at Pierre's -

- Over 16 new crafting and cooking recipes -

- 5 New machines for processing cannabis at Pierre's -

- 4 New buffs for each type of marijuana -
[/b][/size]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/sC5EyzV.png[/img]
[b][size=4]1. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher
[/url]2. Choose Stoned in The Valley or the drug free version (NOT BOTH)
3. Install via Vortex or manually extract the zip in your /Mods folder﻿[/size]
[/b][img]https://i.imgur.com/DitLufM.png[/img]
[size=4]No compatibility issues! Can be used alongside Nature's Bounty but there is no integration between. [/size]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/SKxOGgP.png[/img]
[size=3][b][/b]Crafting: [spoiler]
*Joint Wraps: Crafted with 1 newspaper after reaching farming level 1
*Blunt Wraps: Crafted with 2 dry hemp fiber after reaching farming level 2
*Rose Blunt Wraps: Crafted with 1 dried fairy rose after reaching farming level 3
*CBD Bath Bomb: Crafted with 1 CBD Oil, 1 tea leaves, and 1 clay after reaching farming level 3
*Infused Honey: Crafted with 1 Hybrid Hash Oil and 1 Honey after reaching farming level 3
*CBD Lotion: Crafted with 1 CBD Oil and 1 Coconut after reaching farming level 4
*Indica Dab Pen: Crafted with 1 Indica Hash Oil and 1 Battery Pack after reaching farming level 4 (Gives 10 uses to simulate "hits")
*Sativa Disposable: Crafted with 1 Sativa Hash Oil and 1 Battery Pack after reaching farming level 4 (Gives 10 uses to simulate "hits")
[/spoiler]

Cooking: [spoiler]
*Gummies: 1 Canna Oil and 1 Sugar
*Brownies: 1 Canna Oil, 1 Sugar, and 1 Flour
*Roasted Hemp Seeds: 2 Hemp Seeds
[/spoiler]

Machines: [spoiler]
-Rolling Trays:
*Joints: Crafted at the basic rolling tray with 2 bud or ground bud and a joint wrap
*Blunts: Crafted at the intermediate rolling tray with 2 bud or ground bud and a blunt wrap
*Rose Blunts: Crafted at the expert rolling tray with 2 bud or ground bud and a rose blunt wrap
-Hash Press:
*Hash Oil: Crafted with 4 bud or ground bud at the hash press
-Drying Rack:
*Dry Hemp Fiber: Crafted with 1 hemp at the drying rack
*Dry Bud: Crafted with 1 bud of any kind at the drying rack
*Dry Rose: Crafted with 1 fairy rose at the drying rack
-Grinder:
*Ground Bud: Works the same as regular bud, but the grinder offers a chance of extra output at the cost of time.
-Liquid Infuser:
*Infused Soda: Crafted with 1 hash of any type and 1 Joja Cola at the Liquid Infuser
-Oil Maker:
*Canna Oil: Crafted with 2 bud at the oil maker
-Loom:
*Cloth: Crafted with 10 dry hemp fiber at the loom
[/spoiler]
